thesis: Meb Faber explains that his influential paper on tactical asset allocation originated from a panic to avoid taking a third-level CMT exam after the writing option was discontinued. He simplified the complex trend-following methodology used by institutional commodity trade advisors to make it accessible for individual investors and typical asset allocation portfolios.
